Welcome to the university’s
World Cultures Club!
We provide exciting opportunities for students to immerse
themselves in diverse cultures through craft workshops,
musical evenings, and cooking sessions.
Our next event, the Japanese Tea Ceremony, takes place
on April 10, 3:00 P.M. at the Student Union.
